title: Jeffrey Katzenberg's Startup Negotiates Right to Sell Shuttered Sora to Film Studios
summary:
Former Dropbox CFO Sujay Jaswa and other executives are working to secure deep access to a discontinued video generation tool from OpenAI. An unnamed firm, also co-founded by Bill Peebles—who previously led the Sora project—and movie mogul Jeffrey Katzenberg, intends to customize the model into specialized software for cinematic production. Under the terms being discussed, OpenAI would receive an undisclosed equity stake in the venture in exchange for the rights to modify and monetize the technology.

The effort, reported by The Information, seeks to revive a version of the decommissioned Sora model after OpenAI shuttered the tool. The partnership would combine Peebles' technical knowledge of the original model with Katzenberg's connections to the movie industry to integrate AI video into professional studio workflows.
